title: Grimnir Orchestrator Decision
description: One line of decisions.jsonl — an append-only audit trail of WHY the orchestrator engaged, skipped, dispatched, or deferred a lane. Complements state.json (lifecycle), intel.jsonl (what was found), and event-emitter record-negative (dead-lane outcomes). Adapted from the Kittysploit agent_decision model, re-cast for a delegating PM brain: the reasoning trail that makes /sitrep and /resume explain themselves.

actor.description: Who made the call: grimnir (the orchestrator), operator, or a specialist agent id. Enum, not free text — a filesystem-writing agent must not be able to mint an entry that reads as a genuine human decision.

actor_verified.description: Present when actor=operator. true only when a matching operator-presence token was supplied; false means the 'operator' actor is a RELAYED, unproven claim.

provenance.description: originated = the actor recorded this directly; relayed = another process recorded it on the actor's behalf (see relayed_by). An operator claim without a verified token is always relayed.

relayed_by.description: The process that recorded the entry on the actor's behalf, when provenance=relayed.

authorization.description: Present only on entries that lift a safety boundary (--authorize). A specialist reads status before treating the entry as consent.

status.description: VERIFIED-OPERATOR only with a matching operator-presence token; UNVERIFIED-RELAY otherwise and must NOT be treated as consent to cross a custody/financial/destructive boundary.

source.description: What drove the decision. reachability = the gate matrix; brief = the spend/skip prior; policy = a hunting/never-submit rule; operator = a human call.

decision_type.description: The kind of routing decision.  no-file = a confirmed finding was deliberately NOT submitted; records why, so an unfiled finding can be told apart from an unexamined one.

subject.description: What the decision is about: a lane, a target, an agent, or a playbook id.

chosen.description: The action taken, e.g. 'dispatch specter on bola-cross-tenant'.

alternatives.description: Options considered but not taken (and, ideally, why-not folded into reason).

reason.description: Why this decision was made. Required — the whole point of the log.

reachability_ref.description: Reachability verdict that drove it, e.g. 'BLOCKED(second-account)' or 'REACHABLE'.

playbook_id.description: Linked playbook (rules/playbooks/<id>.yaml) when the decision selected or skipped one.

related_intel.description: Intel entry that prompted the decision.

related_finding.description: Finding this decision produced or acted on.
